summary.intent: Verify that the Entire tool's auto-summarize feature works and populate the Outcome field for a checkpoint, then document findings.
summary.outcome: Auto-summarize was confirmed to fail when invoked inside a Claude Code session due to nested session restrictions; the workaround `env -u CLAUDECODE entire explain --checkpoint <hash> --generate` was validated, observations were documented, and the update was committed.

repo: The Entire tool uses the `claude` CLI to generate summaries and stores structured Outcome fields with Intent, Outcome, Learnings, Friction, and Open Items sections.
Checkpoint trailers are added to commits in the format `Entire-Checkpoint: <hash>`.
workflow: Running `env -u CLAUDECODE entire explain --checkpoint <hash> --generate` bypasses the nested Claude Code session restriction that prevents summary generation from within a Claude Code session.
Auto-summarize on commit works correctly when committing from a terminal outside of Claude Code where `CLAUDECODE` is not set in the environment.
The nested session restriction is controlled by the `CLAUDECODE` environment variable; unsetting it allows the `claude` CLI to spawn normally.

friction: Auto-summarize fails silently during commit with no error surfaced to the user when run inside a Claude Code session.
The `claude` CLI cannot spawn a nested Claude Code session when `CLAUDECODE` is set, blocking Entire's summarize feature from within the IDE integration.
open_items: Investigate whether Entire can surface a warning or error when auto-summarize fails due to the nested session restriction.
Determine if there is a way to make auto-summarize work transparently inside Claude Code sessions without requiring the `env -u CLAUDECODE` workaround.
